Questions

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Do you handle media planning and buying?

We plan channels alongside the creative so the idea is built for where it will run, and work with media partners for buying across Kerala, India and the GCC.

Can you adapt campaigns for Arabic-speaking markets?

Yes. We develop campaigns with GCC audiences in mind and adapt copy and cultural cues with native-language partners rather than translating line by line.

Do you work on single executions or only full campaigns?

Both. Many clients start with a single launch or seasonal push and build from there.
